name: How does GEO differ from traditional SEO for contractors?

mainEntity.name: How does GEO differ from traditional SEO for contractors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional SEO for contractors often relies on manual keyword research, content creation, and technical optimizations. GEO, however, leverages artificial intelligence to automate and enhance these processes, generating tailored content at scale that is highly relevant to specific search queries and local contexts. While traditional SEO focuses on broad keyword rankings, GEO emphasizes generating unique, high-quality content that speaks directly to the user's intent, leading to more qualified leads and better conversion rates by offering more personalized information.
acceptedAnswer.description: GEO uses AI for automated, personalized content generation, while traditional SEO relies more on manual processes and broader keyword targeting for contractors.
